notes: All 50 nodes from the 36 bechina edges are assigned to packages. No orphaned dataset nodes.

The most significant gap is the closing 4-part equation of the opening verse (lines 50-53): Ani H' = yichuda ila'ah; Hu Shmi = yichuda tata'ah; ukevodi = kavod bishleimut; utehilati = dibur. Three of these four are currently missing as bechina edges in the dataset, leaving the Torah's own framing device unrepresented.
The letter vav = tosefot kedushah = shmirat habrit (line 13) is a structurally important bechina that is missing. It bridges Package 1 (upper unity) with Package 6 (shmirat habrit).

Kavod = mayim (line 46) is a notable cross-domain bechina: the concept of honor being 'water-like' (pursued, running, reflecting) appears in both the good and evil dimensions — holy kavod is water that refreshes, pursuit of personal kavod is water that floods. If added, this edge would bridge Package 3 (speech/water/human) with the kavod eitza-chain.

The composite node 'יחודא עלאה ויחודא תתאה' (Package 6) is distinct from the individual nodes in Packages 1-2. This is intentional — the compound node represents the SYNTHESIS of both unifications as the brit's two-dimensional nature, not the individual unifications themselves.
Edge id=665 (כבוד — דבור) was confirmed as type=eitza, not bechina. This is correct: kavod PRODUCES speech (cause→effect), it is not the SAME THING as speech.
